question: In which of the following countries is the headquarters of the International Association of Athletics Federation (IAAF) located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monaco.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The new operational headquarters of the** IAAF** is located at 6-8, Quai Antoine 1er which is on **Monaco's important port of Herculis.**
 
• The total number of countries and territories presently associated with **World Athletics stands at 214.**
 
• This places World Athletics among the world's largest sporting organisations, and with additional members than the** United Nations.**
 
• The International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) will now be called as** World Athletics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Athletics** is a group of sporting events that requires competitive **running, jumping, throwing, and walking.** 
 
• The most usual kinds of athletics competitions are **track and field, road running, cross country running, and racewalking.**
 
• A runner must every time wear** sneakers or athletic shoes during the game**.​
